channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Collision on N40 Slip to N71 Bandon Road R/A
item.description: Reports of a collision at the Bandon Road Roundabout, near the eastbound exit from the N40 towards N71 Bandon Road. Take care on approach.

item.title: Minister McEntee Urges Irish Citizens in Gulf to Shelter in Place as Conflict Disrupts Region
item.description: Government urges Irish citizens in the Gulf, in particular in the UAE to shelter in place as airports shut amid conflict.

item.title: Pedestrian on N25 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a pedestrian on the N25 eastbound, between Midleton and Carrigtwohill. Take extreme care on approach.

item.title: Staying Safe on Cork's Roads: Essential Tips for Driving in Wet and Windy Weather
item.description: Wet and windy conditions across Cork. Reduce speed, use dipped headlights, and avoid flooded roads. No journey is worth the risk. Stay safe.

item.title: Weather Hazards N25 & N40
item.description: Reports of strong crosswinds, surface water and low visibility on Cork roads, in particular the N25 and N40, specifically between Midleton to Ballincollig. Take extreme care on approach.

item.title: Collision on M8 Southbound
item.description: Reports of a collision, southbound, on the M8 Dublin Motorway between Junction 17 (Watergrasshill) and Junction 18 (Glanmire). Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision on Gerald Griffin Street
item.description: Reports of a collision on Gerald Griffin Street, Blackpool. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision on R585 Kealkill
item.description: Reports of a collision (overturned vehicle) on the R585 between Kealkill and Cousane. Emergency services are on scene. Take care on approach.

item.title: Pedestrian on Road on M8 Northbound
item.description: Reports of pedestrian on road, northbound, on the M8 Dublin Motorway between Junction 16 Rathcormac and Junction 15 Fermoy (South) (1 kilometre south of the Rathcormac area). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 1 March at 21:01.

item.title: Cork's Businesses Get a Week of Free Support as Local Enterprise Week Gets Underway
item.description: Local Enterprise Week is underway in Cork City with free events on leadership, exporting and sustainability running until Friday, 6 March. Registration required.
